```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
# Override at render time, e.g.
# quarto render ecrc_figures.qmd -P summary_xlsx:"C:/data/pssp-2026-summary-v2.xlsx" -P monthly_xlsx:"C:/data/pssp-2026-by-month-v4.xlsx"
summary_xlsx = "data/pssp-2026-summary-v2.xlsx"
monthly_xlsx = "data/pssp-2026-by-month-v4.xlsx"
imagery = True        # False skips the satellite basemap (faster; values unchanged)
deck_pptx = "-"       # path to the deck to also check slide numbers, or "-" to skip
out_dir = "figures"
```

```{python}
import os, sys, subprocess
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

for label, path in [("summary_xlsx", summary_xlsx), ("monthly_xlsx", monthly_xlsx)]:
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{label} not found: {path!r}. Pass the real path, e.g. "
                                f'quarto render ecrc_figures.qmd -P {label}:"C:/Users/you/Downloads/file.xlsx"')

# Jupyter on Windows can run as pythonw.exe (no console); use python.exe so errors are visible
py = sys.executable
if os.path.basename(py).lower() == "pythonw.exe":
    py = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(py), "python.exe")

env = dict(os.environ, ECRC_LOG="fig_log.json")
if not imagery:
    env["NO_IMAGERY"] = "1"

def run(args):
    r = subprocess.run([py] + args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{args[0]} failed (exit {r.returncode}):\n" + "\n".join(r.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-25:]))

run(["ecrc_maps.py", summary_xlsx, monthly_xlsx, out_dir])
run(["validate_figures.py", summary_xlsx, monthly_xlsx, "fig_log.json", deck_pptx, "validation_report.csv"])

def md_table(df, fmt=None):
    fmt = fmt or {}
    cols = list(df.columns)
    out = ["| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |", "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in cols) + "|"]
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        out.append("| " + " | ".join(fmt.get(c, str)(r[c]) for c in cols) + " |")
    return Markdown("\n".join(out))

# season table by catch area, straight from the summary workbook
raw = pd.read_excel(summary_xlsx, header=None)
h = raw.index[raw[1].astype(str).eq("Catch area")][0]
ncol = int(raw.iloc[h].last_valid_index()) + 1
S = raw.iloc[h + 1:, 1:ncol].copy(); S.columns = raw.iloc[h, 1:ncol].tolist()
S = S[S["Catch area"].notna()]
S["Catch area"] = S["Catch area"].astype(str).str.replace("_", "-")
S = S.set_index("Catch area")
tot = S.loc["Total"]
```

## Data and methods

Harvest interviews (groups with at least one salmon or steelhead) from Puget Sound Sampling Program creel surveys in Marine Areas 5–13, April 1 to October 7, 2026 (October partial).

- **eCRC share of fish (estimated):** total fish × eCRC licenses ÷ (paper + eCRC licenses), within each area.
- **Scan refusal rate:** refusing anglers ÷ eCRC anglers.
- **Barcode scans:** successful scans. The iForm barcode question appears in a random 60% of eligible interviews (at least one eCRC angler with harvest).
- Cells with fewer than 10 eCRC interviews are hatched on maps and shown as hollow, unconnected points on plots.

```{python}
display(Markdown(
    f"Season totals: **{int(tot['Total interviews']):,}** harvest interviews, "
    f"**{int(tot['eCRC interviews']):,}** with an eCRC angler "
    f"({tot['eCRC interviews'] / tot['Total interviews']:.0%}), "
    f"**{int(tot['Barcode scans']):,}** barcode scans, and "
    f"**{int(tot['Refusing anglers']):,}** of **{int(tot['eCRC anglers']):,}** eCRC anglers refusing a scan "
    f"({tot['Refusing anglers'] / tot['eCRC anglers']:.0%})."))
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-season
#| tbl-cap: "Season to date by catch area."
t = S.drop(index="Total").reset_index()
t = t[["Catch area", "Total interviews", "eCRC interviews", "Barcode scans", "eCRC anglers",
       "Refusing anglers", "% anglers refused", "Total fish", "% fish via eCRC"]]
t.columns = ["Area", "Interviews", "eCRC interviews", "Scans", "eCRC anglers", "Refusing",
             "% refusing", "Fish", "% fish via eCRC (est.)"]
i = lambda v: f"{int(v):,}"; p = lambda v: f"{float(v):.1%}"
md_table(t, {c: i for c in ["Interviews", "eCRC interviews", "Scans", "eCRC anglers", "Refusing", "Fish"]}
            | {"% refusing": p, "% fish via eCRC (est.)": p})
```

## Data checks

Every value drawn in the figures was compared against the source workbooks by `validate_figures.py`, which reads the workbooks independently and checks values, color classes read back from the drawn polygons, hatching, labels, line points and bar heights.

```{python}
v = pd.read_csv("validation_report.csv", encoding="utf-8")
counts = (v.pivot_table(index="figure", columns="status", values="key", aggfunc="count", fill_value=0)
            .reindex(columns=["PASS", "FAIL", "WARN"], fill_value=0).reset_index())
counts.columns = ["Figure / source", "Pass", "Fail", "Warn"]
md_table(counts)
```

```{python}
issues = v[v.status != "PASS"][["status", "figure", "element", "key", "expected", "drawn", "note"]].fillna("")
if len(issues):
    display(Markdown("Checks that did not pass:"))
    display(md_table(issues.rename(columns=str.capitalize)))
else:
    display(Markdown("All checks passed."))
```
